include: Comments and their threads are stored apart from the document, in their own store keyed by the document; files.save() never writes them and the saved file format does not change for them.
Adding, replying to, resolving, reopening or deleting a comment is never a history entry: Undo and Redo never add or remove a comment.
A comment pinned to a layer records the layer id and its point on the canvas; deleting the layer does not delete the comment, which stays at its last point, marked as detached from its layer.
Plugins with the export capability get comment text in comment events; plugins without it get the comment and layer ids only.
Plugin API v1 gains no new member: plugins hear about comments through a new event.
avoid: Storing comments in the document file, for example as a comments list beside the nodes or on each node, or adding them to the saved schema with a migration.
Making comment actions commands on the history, so that Undo can remove or bring back a comment.
Deleting a layer's comments when the layer is deleted.
